decisions.reason: The submarine lighting line required heavy specialized engineering and certification, and it signals maritime competence, so management will persist with it despite its distance from the core and any lumpy demand, which it can attribute to naval procurement cycles.

The explosion-proof industrial line builds on the firm's core strengths, carries substantial certification investment and has a dedicated visible presence, making it central to the announced LED solutions direction.
The designer task light is close to the core offer and was publicly presented on its own page, so weaker sales would be blamed on temporary office-market disruption rather than prompting withdrawal.
The recently launched office pendant fits the energy-efficient LED strategy, and management still sees any shortfall as a pandemic-related, temporary effect on office construction.
The premium pendant line with several models represents a considerable, visible investment aligned with the firm's innovation direction, so management will continue to commit to it.
